notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B) — omnichannel support product. Evaluating Redwood for primary chat agent/triage layer. Wants Hosted API first for speed to market; likely move to Dedicated after 6-12 months if unit economics and latency hold.

Key requirements / ask from product:
- Streaming responses mandatory for UX (token waterfall). must hit <1.5s first-token for typical sessions (target 1.2s).
- Tool/function calling for internal KB lookup, ticket create/update, and realtime enrichment.
- Multi-tenant routing: ability to pin high-priority customers to dedicated pools later.
- Cost sensitivity: average ticket under $0.01/token target; want guidance on batching + caching.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation required, KMS integration for keys, audit logs retention 1 year.

Recent convo highlights (shorthand):
- 2026-01-30 discovery call (Maya) — "streaming is non-negotiable for our UI; we need demo with real KB".
- 2026-02-18 product demo (Ravi + eng lead) — showed Redwood streaming + tool calling; good latency in demo env (~1.0s first-token on small sample). They asked about tail latency under load.
- 2026-03-02 security questionnaire submitted; asked for encryption at rest details + KMS flow. SEC team flagged data residency questions for EU customers.
- 2026-03-06 pricing call — requested 12-month committed cost estimate for Dedicated (baseline 8 GPUs) and incremental hosted overage rates.

POC plan / milestones:
- Week 0: Sign NDA + share sample anonymized ticket dataset (done).
- Week 1: Hosted API POC kickoff — integrate streaming SDK + tool-calls, baseline test harness (target 2k concurrent chat sessions).
- Week 2: Perf run — 10k synthetic sessions, measure p50/p95 first-token and tail. Goal: p50 < 0.8s, p95 < 1.5s.
- Week 3: Quality eval (human eval on 500 sessions) + cost profile report from Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Week 4: Decision review — Hosted contract vs Dedicated sizing recommendation.

POC blockers currently:
- Need written latency SLA for hosted streaming (legal wants fallback language).
- EU data residency for certain enterprise customers (may require Dedicated in region).
- Engineering calendar: two-week blackout starting 2026-03-20 slows POC window.

Quotes / snippets:
- Product lead: "If we can't hit <1.5s first token at scale, customers churn."
- CS lead: "Tool calling latency must be under 200ms for KB lookups or UI will feel sluggish."

Decision signals:
- Positive: liked streaming demo, tool calling flows, Redwood Optimize recommendations looked actionable.
- Negative: wants stronger hosted SLA language and concrete tail-latency numbers at 10k sessions.

Action items for AE/SE:
- Schedule hosted POC perf run w/ infra team (target week starting 2026-03-24).
- Provide drafted hosted SLA addendum & Dedicated sizing/pricing sketch by 2026-03-15.
- Share security artifacts: SOC2 cert, KMS integration diagram, EU residency options.
